content: Dev Chatterjee followed up with insurance agent Anjali Desai regarding the renewal of health policy HP-123456, specifically asking if pre-existing conditions are covered under the new policy. Anjali confirmed that pre-existing conditions are covered, noted a slightly higher premium, and provided an updated quote for review, asking Dev if he wishes to proceed.

Confirm whether to proceed with the policy renewal
